hatchet-migrate runs database migrations for Hatchet.

Usage:
  hatchet-migrate [flags]

Flags:
      --down string         migrate down to a specific version (e.g., 20240115180414).
  -h, --help                help for hatchet-migrate
      --up-to string        migrate up to a specific goose version (e.g., 20260818184000).
      --up-to-penultimate   migrate up to the second-to-last migration version.
      --version             print version and exit.
